exposure: temporary pandemic GDM diagnosis protocols (Australian criteria)
temporary pandemic GDM diagnosis protocols (UK criteria)
cohort: 432 GDM patients attending an outpatient clinic at the University Hospital of Cracow, Poland during 2020.
finding: Temporary pandemic GDM diagnosis protocols from the UK and Australia resulted in 63.0% and 19.9% of GDM cases being missed respectively, with some differences in maternal characteristics for missed cases, but no apparent increase in child or maternal complications compared to non-missed cases.
